claims.claim: Amazon will not build four new data centers on the former George Washington University campus in Loudoun County and will repurpose most of the 122-acre site for mixed-use and residential development.
claims.episode_span: Amazon will not build four new data centers on the former George Washington University campus in Loudoun County
claims.source_title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia
claims.supporting_quote: Amazon will no longer build four new data centers on the site of the George Washington University's campus in Loudoun County, just outside of D.C., and will instead repurpose the majority of the 122-acre space for mixed-use and residential development following significant pushback from the local community.

claims.claim: Amazon will donate 25 acres for a community arts center and recreational facility and give $5 million to Loudoun County's housing fund.
claims.episode_span: Amazon will donate 25 acres to Loudoun County for a community arts center and a recreational facility, and give $5 million to the county’s housing fund.
claims.source_title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia
claims.supporting_quote: It will also donate 25 acres of the property to Loudoun County to be used for a community arts center and new recreational facility. On top of all that, it'll even give $5 million to the county's fund for housing, reports The Washington Post.

claims.claim: Amazon submitted the Loudoun data-center proposal in July and met Chair Phyllis J. Randall in September.
claims.episode_span: The company submitted the data-center proposal in July and met Board of Supervisors Chair Phyllis J. Randall in September.
claims.source_title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia
claims.supporting_quote: Amazon first submitted its proposal to build the new facilities in July, and Loudoun County Board of Supervisors Chair Phyllis J. Randall and Amazon met in September

claims.claim: YMTC is preparing volume production of 9,600 MT/s LPDDR5X at Fab 3 on a VCT 4F² cell, after about 5,000 wafers a month of 7,500 MT/s 16 Gb LPDDR5X at Fab 2 since October 2025.
claims.episode_span: YMTC is preparing volume production of LPDDR5X at 9,600 MT/s at Fab 3
claims.source_title: YMTC to Start Mass Production of LPDDR5X with 9,600 MT/s Speed
claims.supporting_quote: According to Counterpoint Research, YMTC has been producing about 5,000 wafers per month of 16 Gb LPDDR5X DRAM running at 7,500 MT/s at its Fab 2 since October 2025. The company is now preparing to begin volume production of LPDDR5X memory with speeds of 9,600 MT/s at its Fab 3, using Vertical Channel Transistor (VCT) 4F² cell structure technology.

claims.claim: Micron will not commercialize 4F² DRAM and will ramp 1-delta in Boise in the second half of 2027, while CXMT targets a 4F² server DDR5 RDIMM by year-end.
claims.episode_span: Micron will not bring 4F² DRAM to market
claims.source_title: Micron Walks Away From 4F² DRAM After Two Decades of Research, Bets on 3D DRAM Instead
claims.supporting_quote: Micron has decided not to bring 4F² DRAM to market, even though it says it invented the cell design and has been researching it for around two decades.

claims.claim: LattePanda Sigma 2 uses an Intel Core Ultra X7 358H and Arc B390 and is rated up to 180 TOPS INT8 with up to 64 GB of memory.
claims.episode_span: The board is rated at up to 180 TOPS of total AI performance at INT8 and supports up to 64 GB of memory.
claims.source_title: LattePanda Launches LattePanda Sigma 2: The Embeddable AI Single Board Server
claims.supporting_quote: Built around the Intel Core Ultra X7 358H processor with Intel Arc B390 graphics, LattePanda Sigma 2 delivers up to 180 TOPS of total AI performance at INT8 in a compact form factor.

claims.claim: Firebird's first Kazakhstan phase is under construction at Data Center Valley for a third-quarter 2027 commercial launch, under a U.S. export license for 45,000 Grace Blackwell GPUs, with a planned second phase of about 500 megawatts total potential capacity.
claims.episode_span: Firebird’s first phase in Kazakhstan is under construction at Data Center Valley, and a planned second phase would take total potential capacity to about 500 megawatts.
claims.source_title: Kazakhstan Expands Compute for Its AI Future
claims.supporting_quote: Firebird is expanding into Kazakhstan, where it has secured a U.S. export license for 45,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs. The first phase is under construction with Kazakhtelecom at Data Center Valley, targeting commercial launch in the third quarter of 2027.

claims.claim: Kazakhtelecom has deployed 400 H200 and 480 B300 GPUs in Astana and Almaty and plans more than 1,000 GPUs at Data Center Valley plus more than 1,000 Vera Rubin GPUs in Ekibastuz next year.
claims.episode_span: Kazakhtelecom has already deployed 400 NVIDIA H200 and 480 NVIDIA B300 GPUs in Astana and Almaty.
claims.source_title: Kazakhstan Expands Compute for Its AI Future
claims.supporting_quote: Kazakhtelecom , the nation’s largest telecommunications company, has already deployed 400 NVIDIA H200 and 480 NVIDIA B300 GPUs in Astana and Almaty.

claims.claim: Crusoe is to develop a 106-megawatt data center site in Paraguay with Araico.
claims.episode_span: Crusoe’s Paraguay data center site is announced at 106 megawatts, developed with partner Araico.
claims.source_title: Crusoe to develop 106MW data center site in Paraguay

claims.claim: Innio signed a 620-megawatt gas-engine order with an undisclosed U.S. data center developer, following a 1.1-gigawatt order in July.
claims.episode_span: Innio has signed a 620-megawatt gas-engine order with an undisclosed U.S. data center developer.
claims.source_title: Innio signs 620MW gas engine order with undisclosed US data center developer
claims.supporting_quote: Builds on 1.1GW order signed in July

claims.claim: The FCC's first bans under a new chip-level rule cover a HiSilicon dashcam and wireless video transmitter that advertise face detection.
claims.episode_span: The FCC has issued its first bans under a new chip-level rule, covering a dashcam and a wireless video transmitter from HiSilicon
claims.source_title: FCC issues first bans under new chip-level rule
claims.supporting_quote: FCC bans a dashcam and wireless video transmitter produced by HiSilicon, a subsidiary of Huawei for containing an AI chip that advertises face detection algorithms.

claims.claim: A security firm identified 32 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra B300 chips on a China Telecom network, with physical location unclear, and NVIDIA calls smuggling a drop in the bucket.
claims.episode_span: a security firm identified 32 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra B300 chips running inside a China Telecom network
claims.source_title: Illegal Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 GPUs found inside state-owned China Telecom's network
claims.supporting_quote: A security firm has been able to identify 32 Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 AI chips running inside a China Telecom network, but it's unclear where the export-barred components are physically located.

claims.claim: The U.S. Department of Commerce committed up to $389 million in R&D funding for power semiconductors for fusion and advanced computing, with CFS and Helion among recipients.
claims.episode_span: The U.S. Department of Commerce has committed up to $389 million in R&D funding for power semiconductors aimed at fusion and advanced computing.
claims.source_title: US Department of Commerce commits up to $389m in R&D funding to power semiconductors for fusion and advanced computing
claims.supporting_quote: Google-backed CFS and Microsoft-backed Helion to receive R&D funding

claims.claim: QumulusAI expanded Tech Finance Co. equipment lease financing to about $123.6 million from $26 million for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, with TFC funding 85 to 90 percent on three-year leases.
claims.episode_span: QumulusAI expanded an equipment lease with Tech Finance Co. to about $123.6 million, up from $26 million announced in May 2026
claims.source_title: QumulusAI Expands Equipment Lease Financing With Tech Finance Co. To $123.6 Million For NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
claims.supporting_quote: QumulusAI, an Atlanta-based provider of AI cloud infrastructure, has expanded its equipment lease financing arrangement with Tech Finance Co. (TFC) to approximately $123.6 million, up from the previously announced $26 million in May 2026.

claims.claim: Three immersion exposures were treated as cost-parity with one EUV exposure, and four masks made EUV the cheaper option, according to Chris Mack.
claims.episode_span: industry convention held three exposures on an immersion tool at about the same cost as one EUV exposure
claims.source_title: China can make advanced chips without EUV, but the bill keeps growing
claims.supporting_quote: When this transition first began, what everyone in the industry said as conventional wisdom is that cost-wise, three exposures on a 193 immersion tool cost about the same as one exposure on an EUV tool

claims.claim: Morgan Stanley estimated CXMT produced about one-third as many bits per wafer as Western competitors, with the older node accounting for about a third of that shortfall.
claims.episode_span: CXMT was producing only about one-third as many bits per wafer as Western competitors
claims.source_title: China can make advanced chips without EUV, but the bill keeps growing
claims.supporting_quote: In a June report, Morgan Stanley estimated that Chinese DRAM manufacturer CXMT was producing only around one-third as many bits per wafer as Western competitors. The analysts believed the older process node only accounted for around a third of that shortfall
